caption: The drawing features a symmetrical arrangement centered around a large, circular object that is highly decorated with concentric and radiating patterns. Surrounding the central circle are six identical stylized bird figures positioned equidistantly, each with zigzag and wave designs on their bodies and wings. Above the central circle, there is a fan-shaped feature with radiating lines, while below it, there is a rectangular section seen beneath the circle, suggesting a stand or base. The color palette consists exclusively of shades of grey and black on a plain off-white background. All elements are rendered with fine linework and stippling, contributing to the intricate detailing throughout the composition. A signature, "IMBURGE," is present near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Cut Tin Candle Holder
